# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest code on `main`. This project has not
yet published a stable major release.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not disclose vulnerabilities in public issues, discussions, or pull
requests. Use
[GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/zoxilsi/studio/security/advisories/new)
and include:

- the affected page, feature, or commit;
- steps to reproduce or a proof of concept;
- the potential impact; and
- any suggested mitigation.

You should receive an acknowledgement within seven days. We will investigate,
coordinate a fix and release, and credit reporters when requested. Please allow
reasonable time for remediation before public disclosure.
